text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx + timeouts for customer=Silverpine on dedicated-pool sp-3 (us-west-2). 5xx rate spiked to 8% over last 5m, p95 latency 8.2s. Auto-escalation to oncall.
maya (oncall): Ack. paging in. looking now.
maya (oncall): can someone drop the quick summary of impacted endpoints?
rina (support-lead): Customer reports `generate` endpoint timeouts and intermittent 502s. Support ticket #SP-4721 opened; user-visible errors started ~10:12 UTC.
diego (customer-eng): I've messaged Silverpine (CSE) saying we see elevated errors, mitigation in progress, ETA 30-60m.
raj (sre): I'm looking at pool sp-3 metrics: inflight queue length jumped to 240 (normal <40), worker OOMs and preemption events. CPU on controller ok, but GPU worker memory pressure high.
oliver (infra): There's a hot tenant pattern: traces show a single tenant key `silverpine-ml` making lots of long-running stream requests without prefix caching; bypassing cache and causing KV pressure.
maya (oncall): can we throttle that tenant temporarily?
raj (sre): yes — we have per-tenant qps gating. proposing: set tenant_qps(silverpine-ml)=25 and enable short-circuit fallback for large streams.
oliver (infra): Also recommend diverting lower-priority traffic to fallback pool sp-burst-1. I'll prepare a routing rule.
maya (oncall): do it.
deploy-bot: runbook:apply routing-rule --from=sp-3 --to=sp-burst-1 --match=tenant:silverpine-ml --weight=0.6
oliver (infra): applied routing rule, weight=0.6. verifying connections...
raj (sre): applied tenant_qps=25 via config-service. patch id cfg-2026-03-sp3-1.
maya (oncall): any immediate drop in 5xx?
raj (sre): 5m window: 5xx rate dropping from 8% -> 4.6%. p95 dropped from 8.2s -> 4.3s. inflight queue down to ~120. Progressing.
rina (support-lead): notifying customer: we applied temporary throttles and reroutes. asking for any change in their traffic patterns.
diego (customer-eng): Silverpine replied: they did a large backfill job earlier; will pause non-critical jobs. thanks.
maya (oncall): we should also scale sp-3 worker count + bring up spare nodes. oliver can you scale?
oliver (infra): scaling pool sp-3 from 4->8 workers now. command:
```
rictl pool scale --pool sp-3 --replicas 8 --reason "thundering-herd mitigation"
```
apply started. expected ready in ~6m.
raj (sre): note: KV cache evictions spiked — we should enable aggressive prefix caching for this tenant to reduce recompute. adding that to runbook.
maya (oncall): any errors during scale?
oliver (infra): a couple of pods in CrashLoop due to CUDA driver mismatch on one node; isolating and draining that node. running: `kubectl cordon node-az2-gpu-07 && kubectl drain node-az2-gpu-07 --ignore-daemonsets`
deploy-bot: rolling restart requested for workers in sp-3 to pick up cfg-2026-03-sp3-1.
raj (sre): after scale and reroute: 5xx -> 1.7% in last 3m, p95 1.9s, inflight queue ~36. Looks stable.
maya (oncall): good. I'm marking incident as mitigation in progress. moving to monitoring stage.
rina (support-lead): Customer reports partial recovery on their side. ticket updated.
diego (customer-eng): Silverpine wants confirmation when everything is back to normal before resuming backfill.
maya (oncall): leave final decision to Silverpine. we'll hold throttles for 45m and then gradually relax if stable.
sam (sre-lead): quick postmortem actions: 1) Update autoscale thresholds for dedicated pools to trigger earlier on inflight >60. 2) Add tenant-level early throttling runbook step. 3) Add detection for long-running streams that skip prefix caching. 4) Verify driver image rollout for nodes. owners: raj/oliver/sam. schedule retrospective 48h.
raj (sre): creating follow-up tasks: CART-1782 (autoscale policy), CART-1783 (runbook throttle), CART-1784 (stream-detection).
oliver (infra): I'll file infra-345 GPU driver image pin and patch node image in staging.
maya (oncall): final status: mitigated, customer partially impacted but recovering, mitigation actions: tenant throttle, routing reroute to sp-burst-1, pool scaled 4->8, node drain, config patch applied. ETA for full relaxation 45m.
incident-bot: Incident severity annotated -> Sev2. open incident channel if escalates.
rina (support-lead): I'll send a post-mortem note to the customer once RCA is ready.
diego (customer-eng): I'll coordinate customer sync.
maya (oncall): handing off to raj for follow-up. raj you own post-incident and RCA.
raj (sre): taking ownership. will post RCA and timeline. closing thread after follow-ups created. :thumbsup:
